title: repro run does not require repro_bench.csv committed and unmodified, and run.json records no questions sha
goal: repro run refuses while repro_bench.csv or repro_briefs.csv has uncommitted changes, and run.json records their sha256 so record and compare can refuse a frozen set that changed after the run. Found by the SP-ygsnog4n review (S3).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import inspect,bench_repro as b;s=inspect.getsource(b.run_problems);sys.exit(0 if ('status' in s or 'ls-files' in s or 'diff' in s) else 1)

repro_reason: the refusal needs a dirty frozen file in a real checkout; run_problems has no git call on it
